answer: Picture an agent marketplace where every new identity must lock a bond of 50 opal tokens that vests only after a ninety-day horizon of honest work. Voting weight grows with the delta between an agent's verified tasks and its disputed ones, not with how many accounts it runs. A sybil farm of a thousand fake agents therefore ties up fifty thousand opal for months while gaining almost no influence. Detected collusion slashes every linked bond at once, turning cheap identities into costly, illiquid liabilities.
